worldcombat.skill.quickguard.summary: Raises a fast brace a beat before the foe's priority strikes, knocking priority moves (priority above 0) off the user and nearby allies. It holds only a moment and wears through; non-priority attacks pass straight through.
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.use.0: Block a chain of fast priority strikes
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.use.1: Raise the brace a beat before a foe's dash opens
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.use.2: Eat one string of quick hits for the team in the shortest window
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.description: The brace knocks about %1$s priority damage off each covered person and stands for about %2$s, falling when its supply runs out or its time is up.
When raised it covers the user and allies within %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.brace.snap: Snap: absorption x0.75, duration x0.8, radius x0.85, in exchange for -1 tick wind-up and x0.85 cooldown — the fastest raise.
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.brace.stead: Steady: absorption x1.25, duration x1.25, radius x1.05, at +2 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown — holds tighter and longer.
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
Snap: absorption x0.75, duration x0.8, radius x0.85, -1 tick wind-up, x0.85 cooldown — quickest to raise, good for catching a dash as it opens. Steady: absorption x1.25, duration x1.25, radius x1.05, +2 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown — holds tighter and longer, good for eating a whole string of quick hits for the team.
Consider raising the brace when a threat is within this distance; larger predicts earlier but wastes more braces.
When on, the brace is only raised while another ally is inside the alert radius; when off, pressure on the user is enough.
world_combat.move.quickguard.text.ward: Quick Guard turned the priority move
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.description: The brace only turns away enemy priority moves (priority above 0): priority damage comes out of each person's own supply, the brace falls when that runs out so any excess on that hit still lands, and priority status moves are turned aside whole. Non-priority attacks and allies' moves are unaffected. A covered ally that moves too far from the user, or loses line of sight to the user, loses the protection early.
